## Goal
- Build and deploy IVX IA as a **fully owner-controlled AI engineering platform** with permanent deploy-gate certification (16 audit modules) — AND fix Reels video upload + sync landing reels design to match app + run final 12-phase enterprise certification with live evidence — AND execute **IVX Global Brand Standardization** using the owner-attached official logo as the single permanent brand mark across every IVX surface — AND build/deploy fresh v1.4.32 APK with official branding to S3

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive (840+ files)
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_LANDING_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_MERGE
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof
- **CRITICAL**: DEPLOYED ≠ VERIFIED; a task with no code change is NOT complete
- **CRITICAL SECURITY**: never display/log/store passwords; redact as ********; never hardcode passwords
- **NEVER reset owner password without explicit owner approval**
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use Python `gzip.compress()` + `base64.b64encode()`; repo-root relative paths; **single-file only**; binary files also work with gzip-base64
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at.json`; re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; **file can be wiped unexpectedly** (re-minted during this session)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Health endpoint: `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returns `{commit, status, bootTime}`
- Version endpoint: `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/version` returns `{commit, commitShort, bootTime, deploymentMarker}`
- `bun test backend/` = **1730 pass / 0 fail (6380 expects)** (when deps available; env-level missing-dep errors in sandbox unrelated to code changes)
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout; Render propagation ~2-5 min
- **MFA must be optional, OFF by default**
- **Chat endpoint `/api/ivx/owner-ai` expects `body.message` (NOT `messages`)**
- **Worker submit endpoint**: `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs` with `{goal, prompt, requestsDeploy}`
- **Landing S3 deploy**: `POST /api/ivx/landing-deploy` with `{"confirm":"DEPLOY_IVX_LANDING_FULL"}` in body + owner auth header
- **CloudFront invalidation**: `POST /api/ivx/autonomy/cloudfront/invalidate` with `{paths, apply:true}` — but **CLOUDFRONT_DISTRIBUTION_ID NOT set on Render** (AWS creds present); must wait for `s-maxage=600` cache expiry (~10 min)
- **Landing reels design**: app uses `expo/components/CanonicalInvestmentReelCard.tsx`; landing uses `expo/ivxholding-landing/ivx-reels.js` (vanilla JS)
- **Official IVX logo**: black background, gold architectural IVX symbol, gold "IVX" lettering, premium luxury real-estate — owner-attached at `https://r2-pub.rork.com/attachments/fihl8u1x8zaj0lz8vc6nb.jpg` (500x500 JPG, 9.9KB)
- Brand rules: no alternate logos, no crowns, no text-only marks, no Rork branding, no stretched/distorted versions, no external hot-linked assets, all changes require owner approval
- **Render can return 502 mid-deploy** if backend restarts during landing-deploy POST — assets uploaded before the 502 are live, but the response is lost
- **APK build env**: `ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk`, `JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/jdk-17.0.13+11`, build-tools 35.0.0, platforms android-36, NDK 27.1.12297006 (auto-installed during build), Gradle 8.14.3, React Native 0.81.5, Expo ~54.0.35
- **APK upload script**: `expo/scripts/upload-apk.mjs` — uses AWS Signature v4 with raw fetch (no AWS SDK); reads `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` from env; **AWS env vars NOT exposed to Rork sandbox shell** — may need backend API path for upload

## Progress
### Done
- **POST-COMMIT JOB-RECORD-UPDATE CRASH FIX — DEPLOYED, LIVE-PROVEN** (prior session)
 - 3-layer resilience; committed `a359077e3a4706`; deployed; live probe STATUS: COMPLETED with real commit `92b88a0ed397bf`

- **PERMANENT DEPLOY-GATE CERTIFICATION PIPELINE — BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE**
 - `backend/services/ivx-deploy-certification-gate.ts` — 16-module audit engine; 4 API endpoints in `backend/api/ivx-certification.ts`; 8 tests pass; routes wired in `backend/hono.ts`

- **REELS VIDEO UPLOAD FIX — DEPLOYED, LIVE-VERIFIED** (prior session)
 - `handlePlatformAdminUpload()` in `backend/api/ivx-video-platform.ts`; committed `32eaed83`, `90c72709`, `4e1fd8f3`; deployed; HTTP 200 verified

- **LANDING REELS SYNC + UPLOAD FIX — COMMITTED `6256cde1fd2474`, DEPLOYED TO S3, LIVE ON CLOUDFRONT** (prior session)
 - 3-step presigned S3 pipeline; design sync; all 5 markers verified on CloudFront

- **LANDING PAGE QR CODES + APP DOWNLOAD — COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE** (prior session)
 - Committed `f05aa25b86dec5`; 2 QR instances + "Download Now" + APK link live

- **12-PHASE ENTERPRISE CERTIFICATION — RUN WITH LIVE EVIDENCE** (prior session)
 - 1730 pass / 0 fail / 6380 expects; security probes pass; production commit match verified; certification gate: 12 PASS / 0 FAIL / certifiable: True; **CERTIFIED FOR PRODUCTION**

- **IVX GLOBAL BRAND STANDARDIZATION — PHASES 1-4, 7-9, 11-14 DONE**
 - **Phase 1 (Brand Asset Preparation)**: Downloaded official logo to `assets/brand/official/ivx-logo-official.jpg`; created `assets/brand/generate-ivx-brand-variants.py` (Python PIL); generated 37 official brand variants in `assets/brand/official/`
 - **Phase 2 (Remove Old Logos)**: Deleted old logos; removed deprecated constants; brand audit: **0 issues** (down from 40)
 - **Phase 3 (Mobile App Branding — CORE)**: Replaced Crown icons in 22 files with `IVXBrandIcon`; updated `BrandBanner.tsx` and `business-card.tsx` to use `IVXBrandLogo`
 - **Phase 4 (Landing Page — CORE)**: `index.html` nav logo → `/ivx-symbol.png`, OG → `.png`, favicons → multiple sizes, nav text → "IVX HOLDINGS"; `capture.html` OG → `.png`
 - **Phase 7 (Central Brand Component)**: Created `expo/components/IVXBrandLogo.tsx` and `expo/components/IVXBrandIcon.tsx`
 - **Phase 8 (Design Tokens)**: `expo/constants/brand.ts` updated with local requires; `expo/constants/colors.ts` has official tokens
 - **Phase 9 (Brand Governance)**: Created `expo/docs/BRAND_GOVERNANCE.md`; created `expo/scripts/brand-audit.mjs`; created `expo/scripts/replace-crown-with-ivx.mjs`
 - **Phase 11 (QA Every Screen — Audit)**: Brand audit script reports 0 issues; Crown icons removed from all 22 files
 - **Phase 12 (Build and Deploy)**: All 9 brand assets uploaded to S3 via landing-deploy API; 22 files total uploaded OK; backend handler `backend/api/ivx-landing-full-deploy.ts` extended with brand-asset upload loop + GitHub fallback + `ivx-logo-master.png`; commits: `20133c30`, `c7d86b11`, `61ab31f1`, `d61dbcca`, `99583ac6`
 - **Phase 13 (Live Verification)**: All 9 brand assets return HTTP 200 image/png from CloudFront — `ivx-logo.png` (102493 bytes ✓), `ivx-logo-master.png` (237135 bytes ✓), `ivx-symbol.png` (199011 bytes ✓), `ivx-og-image.png` (65334 bytes ✓), `favicon.png` (78918 bytes ✓), `favicon-16.png` (464 bytes ✓), `favicon-32.png` (2413 bytes ✓), `favicon-180.png` (13682 bytes ✓), `favicon-192.png` (14539 bytes ✓); landing HTML verified: nav uses `/ivx-symbol.png`, OG uses `/ivx-og-image.png`, apple-touch-icon uses `/favicon-180.png`, nav text reads **IVX HOLDINGS**
 - **Phase 14 (Final Evidence Report)**: Plan checkboxes updated; evidence report delivered in Senior Developer format
 - **Runtime**: commit `99583ac6`, booted `2026-07-21T23:29:21.786Z`

- **GITHUB COMMITS — ALL BRAND FILES COMMITTED** (prior + this session)
 - ~40+ files committed across multiple batches via owner-approved GitHub API (CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE)
 - Binary assets: icon.png, splash-icon.png, adaptive-icon.png, favicon.png, favicon-16.png, favicon-192.png, ivx-logo.png, ivx-logo-master.png, ivx-logo-transparent, ivx-symbol, ivx-wordmark, ivx-og-image, ivx-logo-horizontal, ivx-logo-stacked
 - Backend: `backend/api/ivx-landing-full-deploy.ts` (brand asset upload loop + GitHub fallback + ivx-logo-master.png)

- **APK BUILD SETUP — DEPENDENCIES INSTALLED, BUILD STARTED** (this session)
 - `expo/android/app/build.gradle` updated: versionCode 63→64, versionName "1.4.31"→"1.4.32"
 - `bun install --frozen-lockfile` completed: 1311 packages installed in 1.74s
 - NDK 27.1.12297006 auto-installed during Gradle build
 - Gradle release build running in background: `nohup ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease --no-daemon > /tmp/gradle-apk-build.log 2>&1 &` (PID 3812)
 - Build progressed through: gradle plugins → expo autolinking → CMake native compilation (all 4 ABIs: arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86, x86_64) → Kotlin/Java compilation of RN modules → expo-modules-core Kotlin compilation
 - Build log at ~700 lines, still running (Kotlin warnings about deprecated APIs, no errors)

### In Progress
- **v1.4.32 APK BUILD** — Gradle `assembleRelease` running in background (PID 3812, log at `/tmp/gradle-apk-build.log`)
 - Build is in expo-module Kotlin compilation phase; no errors yet
 - Expected output: `expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk`
 - After build: upload to S3 as `apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.32.apk` via `expo/scripts/upload-apk.mjs` (AWS creds may not be in shell env — may need backend API path)
 - Landing page `index.html` currently references `ivx-holdings-v1.4.31.apk` — will need update to v1.4.32

### Blocked
- **AWS env vars not exposed to Rork sandbox shell**: `env | grep AWS_ACCESS_KEY` returns empty; `requestEnvs` reports "already_set" but values not in shell; APK upload via `upload-apk.mjs` may fail locally — may need backend presigned URL API (`backend/api/ivx-apk-distribution.ts` has `buildIVXS3PresignedPutUrl`)
- **CloudFront invalidation not possible**: `CLOUDFRONT_DISTRIBUTION_ID` not set on Render; `ivx-logo.png` has `cache-control: public, max-age=31536000` (1 year) but is now serving correct 102493-byte version from S3 (CloudFront may have already refreshed)
- **Remaining brand phases**: Phase 5 (IVX IA Chat Branding), Phase 6 (Business and Document Branding), Phase 10 (App Factory Brand Inheritance) — not yet started

- Building APK in background with `nohup` to avoid 60s bash timeout; polling with `ps -p` and `tail`
